name: Andaz Bali, by Hyatt
short_description: A 149-room beachfront Andaz in Sanur, with locally inspired design, beach pool villas, and a notably strong breakfast.
ai_summary: Andaz Bali sits on a beachfront plot along Sanur beach, Bali's east coast, in a calmer and quieter area than the island's busier tourist strips. Guests consistently praise the locally inspired, design-forward rooms and a breakfast spread reviewers call a genuine selling point, alongside the resort's Garden and Beach Pool Villas for those wanting more privacy. Adjacent to the more affordable Hyatt Regency Bali, it commands a real price premium some travelers question, though most agree the room quality and breakfast justify at least part of the gap.

core_facts.address: Jalan Danau Tamblingan 89a, Sanur, Bali 80228, Indonesia
elite_benefits: Complimentary full breakfast daily for World of Hyatt Globalist Elite members at properties without a dedicated club lounge, per World of Hyatt program terms
Room upgrades for Explorist and Globalist Elite members, subject to availability
Late check-out until 4pm for Globalist Elite members, subject to availability

pros: Beachfront in Sanur, a calmer and quieter part of Bali than its busier tourist areas
Locally inspired, design-forward rooms draw consistently strong praise
Breakfast is repeatedly singled out as excellent and a genuine reason to book
Garden and Beach Pool Villas available for guests wanting more privacy
Three outdoor pools and four dining venues at Village Square
cons: The beach itself has limited swimmability compared with some other Bali coastlines
Commands a real price premium over the adjacent Hyatt Regency Bali that some reviewers question
research_highlights: Rooms are repeatedly called stunning, with locally inspired design and spacious layouts
Breakfast quality is singled out as a standout, better than at the adjacent Hyatt Regency
The family-friendly atmosphere and beachfront villas draw strong praise
research_watchouts: A review questions whether the resort is worth double the price of the adjacent Hyatt Regency Bali, despite the stronger breakfast
The beach itself is noted as having limited swimmability

faqs.question: Is Andaz Bali worth the extra cost over Hyatt Regency Bali next door?
faqs.answer: Reviewers are divided -- room design and breakfast are consistently rated higher at Andaz Bali, and some call the breakfast alone a selling point, but at least one reviewer felt it wasn't worth double the Hyatt Regency's rate, so it depends on how much design and breakfast quality matter to you.

faqs.question: Can you swim at the beach in front of Andaz Bali?
faqs.answer: Swimmability is limited compared with some other Bali coastlines, so most guests use the resort's three outdoor pools -- including the Garden and Beach Pool Villas -- as the primary swimming option, treating the beach itself more as a spot for walks, sunset views, and beachfront lounging than for swimming laps.

reviews.title: Review: Andaz Bali, a lush tropical beachside resort
reviews.summary: Praises the stunning, locally-inspired room design and spacious layouts in quieter Sanur, noting the beach itself has limited swimmability, and calls the family-friendly atmosphere an appealing alternative to Bali's busier areas.
